proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant family for class features
proposed_widenings.justification: Ability Score Improvement is a permanent passive feature granted on leveling up. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', whose header mandates activationCost, resource (UseCountResource), and resetCadence. None of those fields exist for ASI — it has no activation, no use count, and no rest reset. A new 'passive_grant' (or 'level_grant') family is needed for permanently-applied, non-activated class features.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat_choice effect variant in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit's core mechanic is granting the player a feat selection. ClassFeatureEffect only covers GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect. A new variant is needed to represent 'gain a feat (defaulting to ASI feat) or another qualified feat'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

notes: The TAXONOMY v4 §12 explicitly records 'modify_ability_score as a runtime effect versus as pre-runtime character state (currently treated as out-of-scope)'. ASI is firmly pre-runtime character state — it modifies the character sheet at level-up, not during combat. The structural gap is that ClassFeatureMechanics only models the activation family; every class in the SRD has ASI entries (or equivalent) at multiple levels, so a passive_grant family would unblock an entire category of cross-class features. No .dhall or .json content files are written for this unit.
